sentences.en: Fire is hot and bright.
Use a knife to cut the string.

sentences.zh: 他用锤子把钉子钉进木头里。

sentences.en: Tie the box with a strong string.
sentences.zh: 用牢固的绳子捆住盒子。

sentences.en: The wheel is round. It turns.
I use a stick to push the ball.
Metal is hard and strong.
The machine does the work for us.
The engine in the car is loud.
sentences.zh: 汽车里的引擎声音很大。

sentences.en: I can make a box from wood.
sentences.zh: 我可以用木头做一个盒子。

sentences.en: She makes a cake with flour and eggs.
sentences.zh: 她用面粉和鸡蛋做一个蛋糕。

sentences.en: Do not touch the fire. It is dangerous.
Cut the string with this knife.
The chain on the gate was strong.
I used a screw to keep the board in place.
sentences.zh: 我用螺丝把木板固定住。

sentences.en: The blade of the knife was sharp.
The fork and the spoon are on the table.
I put water into the pot and let it heat.
My hands were covered in dust from the work.
sentences.zh: 我的手沾满了工作产生的灰尘。

sentences.en: The steel blade is stronger than iron.
Copper and brass are used for wire.
I used a cord to tie the box.
The frame of the window was made of wood.
I used a match to light the fire.
The edge of the tool was damaged.
I put a piece of cork in the bottle.
sentences.zh: 我把一块软木塞放进瓶子里。

sentences.en: The gun was not a toy. It was a dangerous thing.
sentences.zh: 枪不是玩具。它是危险的东西。

sentences.en: A pump is a machine for moving water.
sentences.zh: 水泵是一种移动水的机器。

sentences.en: I need a new blade for these scissors.
sentences.zh: 我需要一把新的刀片来用这把剪刀。

sentences.en: The nut on the screw was tight.
The whip was made of leather.
Poison is a dangerous substance that can kill.
sentences.zh: 毒药是一种危险的物质，可以致死。

sentences.en: The chain had a knot in it.
Lead is a heavy metal.
